acceptanceCriteria: Each Core read command is non-mutating, resource-bounded and deterministic on frozen inputs.
Go deep analysis and cross-language limits are stated exactly; unsupported scope widens or abstains.
Hostile path, symlink, case-fold, malformed input and budget cases fail visibly without invented certainty.
body: Qualify the read-only evidence compiler after its wire contracts are frozen. This ticket promotes no language family without current conformance.
title: Qualify the read-only Core evidence compiler
